alpha_policy: The uninflected technical label alpha identifies the compositing coefficient. Surrounding prose is translated and describes combining the source-image and background colours using or based on alpha. It is not an English compositing placeholder or a claim that a new local jargon term is established. The whole messages below are indivisible resource proposals, not runtime templates.

interpretation.ain-Latn: Using alpha, we/one mix the image's colour and the background colour. Generic a= subject; neither an instruction to the user nor an alpha-removal statement.
interpretation.ain-Kana: Exact paired reading of the Ainu Latin message, including a=ukopoye as アウコポイェ.
interpretation.bo: Mixing the image's colour and the background colour on the basis of alpha.
interpretation.dz: Mixing together the image's colour and the background colour based on alpha.
interpretation.hak-Hant-TW: Mixing the image's colours and the background colour according to alpha.
interpretation.hak-Latn-TW: Exact Hakka Pha̍k-fa-sṳ pairing of the Han message; not MOE-romanization conversion.
interpretation.jje: Mixing the image colour and background colour with alpha as the basis.
interpretation.mn-Mong: Combining the image's colour and the background colour using alpha.
interpretation.mnc-Mong: Mixing the image's colour and the background colour according to alpha. Reading: alpha i songkoi nirugan i boco jai amargi boco be suwaliyara.
interpretation.ryu: Mixing the image's colour and background colour using alpha. Mixing predicate is Okinawan transitive majiyun, not Japanese majiru.
interpretation.vi-Hani: Kết hợp ảnh và nền dựa trên alpha. Combining the image and the background based on alpha. SVG phrase reads kích thước gốc.

hard_blocks_on_unsubstantiated_alternati: Do not reuse Ainu a=ukomare as if independently verified: exact ukomare search had no hit in the museum dictionary or checked modern glossary. This does not prove it is invalid; ukopoye is affirmatively attested and is used instead.
Do not interpret alpha compositing as deleting an alpha channel, painting only transparent pixels, setting opacity, changing transparency, or applying equal-weight colour averaging.
Do not use Manchu daci as a noun-modifying original merely because ui_original_size34 contains it; da kemun has separate catalogue and prior grammar evidence.
Do not claim the Nôm catalogue's 蹺 was independently verified as theo by the inspected Chunom page: it supplies nghều only. Use the independently retrieved dựa trên compound instead.
Do not mechanically transliterate Cyrillic Mongolian into the Traditional Mongolian proposal. The new combine lemma is directly printed by the Mongoltoli entry in Traditional script.
No candidate is dictionary-certified as a complete sentence; no structural or glyph check constitutes fluency acceptance.
